topic: Adding CSV export to an existing reports page, including very large reports.
checker_notes: Minor: step 3 of reference_artifact says the API sends the 200 and the CSV header row before its first replica read, so the step 3 branch "if the replica fails before any bytes are sent, the API returns 503" (also in the q12 key) cannot happen as written; say that the first 500-row batch is read before the status line and header are sent, and make the same change in seeded_presentation.

Minor: the q2 key is a brief-kind item but includes the reference's own detail "(its id and status)", which the brief does not settle (it only says the click returns the existing export); cut it to "No second export or job is started; the existing queued or running export is returned and the page shows its status" so a grader does not mark down plans that return the export without listing those exact fields.
